sloka: अरण्यम् च सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन गमिष्यति ।तस्मिन् अर्थे नियुक्तः सन् पित्रा सत्य पराक्रमः ॥४-६२-५॥
transliteration: araṇyam ca saha bhrātrā lakṣmaṇena gamiṣyati ।tasmin arthe niyuktaḥ san pitrā satya parākramaḥ ॥4-62-5॥

translations.english: 'On account of the command of his father, Rama armed with the strength of truth will proceed to the forest with his brother Lakshmana.
